description: Fuel prices at forecourts near a UK postcode or place, from the government's Fuel Finder data (updated every 15 minutes), in two orders: lowest pump price, and best value for the driver (the pump price plus the fuel used driving there and back, from the car's mpg and how many litres they buy). Says when the data is out of date.

fuel.description: E10 (unleaded petrol), E5 (super unleaded), B7 (diesel) or SDV (premium diesel); "petrol" and "diesel" work too

litres.description: how many litres they buy, for best value (default 40)

mpg.description: the car's miles per gallon (UK), for best value (default 45, a typical family car)

radius_km.description: how far to look, in km (default 5)

where.description: a UK postcode (e.g. LS1 4AP), postcode district (e.g. W5) or place name (e.g. Leeds, Hanwell)

name: fuel_prices_near
title: Fuel prices near a postcode
